name: Ribbon Twist
description: Upright ribbons twisting about their own length down the sheet, flashing a warm face and a cool back as they turn.

code.style: --rule: ( --a: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2)); --wa: $(round((42 * cos(2 * PI * (1.6 * (@y - 1) / @Y + 0.21 * @x))) * 1000) / 1000); --wb: $(round((42 * cos(2 * PI * (1.6 * (@y) / @Y + 0.21 * @x))) * 1000) / 1000); --ea: $(round((wa - (wb - wa) * 0.02) * 100) / 100); --eb: $(round((wb + (wb - wa) * 0.02) * 100) / 100); --tc: $(round((max(0, min(100, 100 * wa / (wa - wb + 0.0001)))) * 100) / 100); --bow: polygon($(50 - ea)% -2%, $(50 + ea)% -2%, $(50 + eb)% 102%, $(50 - eb)% 102%); --fa: linear-gradient(180deg, @match($(wa) > 0, #000, transparent) 0 $(tc)%, @match($(wb) > 0, #000, transparent) $(tc)% 100%); --fb: linear-gradient(180deg, @match($(wa) < 0, #000, transparent) 0 $(tc)%, @match($(wb) < 0, #000, transparent) $(tc)% 100%); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @var(--a); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--bow); clip-path: @var(--bow); -webkit-mask: @var(--fa); mask: @var(--fa); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color3), var(--color4)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--bow); clip-path: @var(--bow); -webkit-mask: @var(--fb); mask: @var(--fb); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
